title: USA F-1 student visa application and interview documents — Department of State
text:
USA student visa application overview (F-1 academic study). Admission to a SEVP-approved school precedes SEVIS registration, the I-901 SEVIS fee and school issuance of Form I-20. Follow the applying embassy or consulate's instructions; procedures vary. Submit DS-160 and print its confirmation page.

For the visa interview, prepare a passport valid for US travel, DS-160 confirmation, application-fee receipt if payment is required beforehand, and Form I-20 signed by the student and school official. Passport validity normally extends six months beyond the stay, subject to country-specific agreements. Upload a compliant photo; bring a printed compliant photo if upload fails.

Additional evidence may cover academic preparation, intent to leave after study, and funding for educational, living and travel expenses. These are preparation topics, not guaranteed interview questions or approval criteria sufficient by themselves. Consular officers decide eligibility; additional administrative processing may be needed. A visa does not guarantee admission: CBP decides at entry. This summary is not an exhaustive checklist.
